The '''Treaty of Malastare''' was a bilateral treaty ratified by the [[Malastarian council/Legends|Malastarian council]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] following the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The treaty guaranteed the Republic continued access to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare's]] substantial reserves of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] in return for the elimination of the gargantuan [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] and Republic protection from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
===Background===
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="TZB" /> invaded [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] with a massive [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]]. As a key Republic [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] world, Malastare's substantial reserves of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]]<ref name="OFEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> made it a target for the resource-hungry Separatists. While outnumbered, the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] artillery fought doggedly with assistance from Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] reinforcements. When it appeared the Republic would lose, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] authorized the deployment of the prototype [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] which immobilized the droid forces rapidly, wiping out resistance.<ref name="TZB" />

[[File:Treaty_of_Malastare.png|thumb|left|200px|The treaty is signed.]]

However, the blast opened a crater where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] discovered a slumbering [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], a gargantuan ancient species which had preyed on the sapient Dug natives in ancient times. The Dug leader [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]] ordered his troops to kill the beast by dropping fuel and bombs dropped into the crater. Their actions provoked the beast, which emerged from its crater and rampaged the emaciated Republic and Dug forces.<ref name="TZB" />

Fearing an apocalyptic doom, the Dugs refused to ratify the treaty unless the Republic destroyed the Zillo Beast. Believing that this would lead to the death of an innocent life form, Windu refused but was overruled by Palpatine who publicly agreed to destroy the monster. However, he and Skywalker secretly connived to immobilize the beast and then arrange for it to be transported to an undisclosed [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] world for scientific research. Using a squadron of [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|RX-200 ''Falchion''-class assault tanks]], the Jedi dazed the beast with well-placed energy beams which rendered it unconscious and made it appear to be dead.<ref name="TZB" />

===Aftermath===
With both the Separatists and the Zillo Beast eliminated, the [[Malastarian council/Legends|Malastarian council]] convened and granted permission for the Republic to use Malastare's fuel reserves to power its expanded [[Republic Navy/Legends|star fleet]] which was engaged against Separatist forces across the span of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In reality, the Zillo Beast was not dead but had been shipped to the galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be studied under a contained environment following a change of plans.<ref name="TZB" /> Still, the treaty afforded Malastare's place as a key Republic member-world throughout the Clone Wars and the subsequent [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Treaty of Malastare was first introduced in "[[The Zillo Beast]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]].<ref name="TZB" /> It confirmed Malastare's role as a key Republic member world during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, the cartoon episode's portrayal of a governing [[Malastarian council/Legends|Dug Council]] capable of providing defense and conducting foreign relations appeared to contradict several other sources which placed the immigrant [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] and the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] as the ''de facto'' government of Malastare. These sources also stated that the dominant Gran disenfranchised and stripped the indigenous Dugs of political power.<ref name="Gran in the Databank">{{DB|species|gran|Gran}}</ref><ref name="Galaxy Guide 12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref><ref name="TNEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Eventually, [[Leland Chee]] retconned this contradiction by stating that the planet's fuel resources were administered by the Dugs' council.<ref name="Retcon">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/11946627956|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=The fuel reserves are not controlled by the Gran-led planetary government thus the need for a separate treaty with the Dugs.|archivedate=20200329175118}}</ref>
